audience.programmeDescription: Ancient Studies at VU and the University of Amsterdam examines the ancient Mediterranean and Near East through texts, material remains, history, literature and philosophy. Students choose a specialisation and complete research on an ancient-world topic.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers ancient archaeology, Greek democracy, comparative myth and selected ancient philosophy and history. The joint VU and University of Amsterdam curriculum brings those fields together in a sustained sequence on the ancient Mediterranean and Near East. UCR’s courses cover parts of that sequence.

curriculum.limitation: This 180 EC plan illustrates the Dutch track with Ancient History. It includes two orientation choices, 30 EC of open study and a 12 EC thesis with colloquium. Thesis entry requires passing all first- and second-year courses.

componentNotes.y1-elect-seminar: One of two first-year orientation choices.
componentNotes.y1-elect-myth: One of two first-year orientation choices.
componentNotes.y3-elective: Open study can include a minor, approved courses, study abroad or an internship.
componentNotes.y3-thesis: The 12 EC includes the thesis and colloquium.
